import re
from copy import copy

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.cell.rich_text import CellRichText, TextBlock

from openpyxl.utils import column_index_from_string

sheet_name = "Sheet1"
target_col = column_index_from_string("BD")
first_answer_row = 2
last_answer_row_limit = 308

# Load once for editing/preserving workbook, and once data_only for computed displayed values.
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, rich_text=True)
ws = wb[sheet_name]

wb_values = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)
ws_values = wb_values[sheet_name]

# Treat the editable pattern list as the non-empty labels before column BD in row 1.
# This keeps the code data-driven for hidden files with different labels.
patterns = []
for col in range(2, target_col):
    val = ws_values.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    if val is None:
        continue
    if isinstance(val, float) and val.is_integer():
        val = int(val)
    pat = str(val).strip()
    if pat:
        patterns.append(pat)

# Longest patterns first so phrases win over shorter overlapping terms.
patterns = sorted(set(patterns), key=«redacted» x: len(x), reverse=True)

def pattern_to_regex(pat):
    """Build a case-insensitive whole-word/whole-number regex for a pattern."""
    # Allow one or more whitespace characters where the pattern has whitespace.
    parts = re.split(r"\s+", pat.strip())
    escaped = r"\s+".join(re.escape(p) for p in parts if p != "")
    if not escaped:
        return None

    # Whole word/number boundaries based on alphanumeric chars, so "too" won't match "took".
    left = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])" if pat[0].isalnum() else ""
    right = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9])" if pat[-1].isalnum() else ""
    return re.compile(left + escaped + right, re.IGNORECASE)

compiled_patterns = [rx for rx in (pattern_to_regex(p) for p in patterns) if rx is not None]

red_bold_font = InlineFont(b=True, color="FFFF0000")
normal_font = InlineFont(b=False, color="FF000000")
base_font = Font(bold=False, color="FF000000")

def find_non_overlapping_spans(text):
    spans = []
    occupied = [False] * len(text)

    for rx in compiled_patterns:
        for m in rx.finditer(text):
            start, end = m.span()
            if start == end:
                continue
            if any(occupied[start:end]):
                continue
            spans.append((start, end))
            for i in range(start, end):
                occupied[i] = True

    spans.sort()
    return spans

def make_rich_text(text, spans):
    rt = CellRichText()
    pos = 0
    for start, end in spans:
        if start > pos:
            rt.append(TextBlock(normal_font, text[pos:start]))
        rt.append(TextBlock(red_bold_font, text[start:end]))
        pos = end
    if pos < len(text):
        rt.append(TextBlock(normal_font, text[pos:]))
    return rt

last_row = min(ws.max_row, last_answer_row_limit)

for row in range(first_answer_row, last_row + 1):
    source_value = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=target_col).value
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=target_col)

    if source_value is None or str(source_value) == "":
        continue

    text = str(source_value)
    spans = find_non_overlapping_spans(text)

    cell.font = copy(base_font)
    if spans:
        cell.value = make_rich_text(text, spans)
    else:
        cell.value = text

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
